paragraphs.source_en: Al-Qahira is the name for Mars in Arabic, and Malaysian, and Indonesian. The latter two langauges got it from the former; look at a globe, then, and see how far the Arabs' religion spread. The whole middle of the world, from West Africa to the West Pacific. paragraphs.source_en: The Arabs who live out of Arabia are called Mahjaris, and the Arabs who came to Mars, the Qahiran Mahjaris. When they arrived on Mars a good number of them began to wander Vastitas Borealis ("The Northern Badia") and the Great Escarpment. These wanderers were mostly Bedouin Arabs, and they traveled in caravans, in a deliberate recreation of a life that had disappeared on Earth. People who had lived in cities all their lives went to Mars and moved around in rovers and tents. The excuses for their ceaseless travel included the hunt for metals, areology, and trade; but it seemed clear that the important thing was the travel, the life itself.
